entries.jp: ぬぅ\n参った……
entries.en: Nngh... I'm\nstumped...

entries.jp: まさかこんな事に\nなるとは
entries.en: Who'd have\nthought it would\ncome to this?

entries.jp: この土方歳三\n一生の不覚だ
entries.en:
I, Toshizo
Hijikata, have
made the blunder
of a lifetime.

entries.jp: 不覚ですねー
entries.en: Quite the\nblunder~

entries.jp: う～ん\n悩みます……
entries.en: Hmm... What\na dilemma...

entries.jp: そうだねー\n困ったねー
entries.en: Yeah~ What\na pickle~

entries.jp: フン……
entries.en: Hmph...

entries.jp: ここは江戸にある\n勝海舟の屋敷
entries.en:
This is the
mansion of
Kaishu Katsu,
in Edo.

entries.jp:
雷舞会場として
使えそうな程　広々とした
和室の隅で　高杉　桂
土方　沖田の四人は
膝を突き合わせていた
entries.en:
In a corner of a
tatami room big
enough to host a
live, Takasugi,
Katsura, Hijikata
and Okita sat
knee to knee.

entries.jp: 四人の真ん中には\n小さな箱が置かれている
entries.en: In the middle\nof the four sat\na small box.

entries.jp: 中には　一組の紅白饅頭が\n仲良く寄り添って\n納まっていた
entries.en:
Inside, a pair
of red and
white manju
nestled snugly
side by side.

entries.jp: 箱の中の饅頭は　二つ\n今ここにいる人数は　四人
entries.en: Two manju in\nthe box. Four\nof us here.

entries.jp: これでは四人全員に\n饅頭が行き渡らない
entries.en:
That means
there aren't
enough manju
to go around.

entries.jp: ここはひとつ\nこの私　桂小五郎に\n任せてください
entries.en: Leave this one\nto me, Kogoro\nKatsura.

entries.jp: 閃きました\nこうしたらどうです？
entries.en: I've got it! How\nabout this?

entries.jp: どうするの？
entries.en: How about what?

entries.jp: 簡単な事です\n二つの饅頭を\n半分に割るのです
entries.en: It's simple. We\nsplit each of the\ntwo manju in half.

entries.jp: そうすれば平等に\n四人に行き渡ります\nどうです　名案でしょう
entries.en:
That way, all
four of us get
an equal share.
Well? A brilliant
idea, isn't it?

entries.jp: 却下だ
entries.en: Rejected.

entries.jp: えええええっ\n何故ですかっ
entries.en: Whaaaat!?\nBut why!?

entries.jp: それはオレ様のセリフだ\n桂さんともあろう人が\nオレは情けないぜ
entries.en:
That's my line!
I'm ashamed of
you, Katsura-san.
You of all people!

entries.jp: この饅頭を\n割れるワケねぇだろ
entries.en: There's no way\nwe can split\nthese manju!

entries.jp: うむ\n高杉の言う通りだ
entries.en: Indeed.\nTakasugi's right.

entries.jp: いいか　桂\n分かってるだろうが\nこれは只の饅頭ではない
entries.en:
Listen, Katsura.
You should know
this already.
These are no
ordinary manju.

entries.jp: 征夷大将軍\n徳川慶喜様から\n賜った饅頭なんだぞ
entries.en:
These manju
were bestowed
upon us by the
shogun himself,
Yoshinobu-sama!

entries.jp: ――そうなのである
entries.en: --Indeed\nthey were.

entries.jp:
この饅頭は　半日前に
行われた慶喜の誕生祭に
駆り出された　高杉　桂
土方　沖田の四人が
報酬として受け取った
ものなのだ
entries.en:
They were the
pay Takasugi,
Katsura, Hijikata
and Okita got
for being roped
into Yoshinobu's
birthday festival
half a day ago.

entries.jp:
四人に報酬を渡した
役人によると　饅頭は
結構な数を用意していた
らしいのだが――
entries.en:
According to
the official who
paid them, a
good number of
manju had been
prepared, but--

entries.jp:
想像以上に祭りが
盛り上がり　大勢の人が
集まったため
饅頭はあっと言う間に
無くなってしまったらしい
entries.en:
the festival
was livelier
than expected,
drawing such
a crowd that
the manju ran
out in no time.

entries.jp: まあ　当然だよね\n僕達　新選組が\n雷舞をやったんだし
entries.en:
Well, naturally.
We, the
Shinsengumi,
put on a live,
after all.

entries.jp: 大盛り上がりの\n大騒ぎになっちゃうのは\n仕方がないよ　うん
entries.en:
Of course it
turned into a
huge, wild
frenzy. Can't
be helped. Yep.

entries.jp: 総司　今はそういう話を\nしてるんじゃない
entries.en:
Soji, that's not
what we're
talking about
right now.

entries.jp: この饅頭は\n慶喜様の御心だ
entries.en: These manju are\nYoshinobu-sama's\ngoodwill.

entries.jp: その饅頭を割るということ\nそれ即ち慶喜様への謀反と\nみなすが――
entries.en:
Splitting them
would be
considered
treason against
Yoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: そういうことか？\nそれでいいんだな？
entries.en: Is that what you\nmean? You're\nfine with that?

entries.jp: ちっ　違いますよ！\nどうしてそういう話に\nなるんですか
entries.en: N-no, of course\nnot! How did it\ncome to that!?

entries.jp: 私はただ　報酬を\n四等分にする方法を\n提案しただけです！
entries.en:
All I did was
suggest a way to
divide the reward
four ways!

entries.jp: ならば却下だ
entries.en: Then it's rejected.

entries.jp: 饅頭を割ることは\nこの土方歳三が許さん
entries.en:
I, Toshizo
Hijikata, will not
allow the manju
to be split.

entries.jp: ちょっと待てよ\n饅頭を割る割らない以前に\nこれは全部オレ様のだろ？
entries.en: Hold on. Split or\nnot, aren't these\nall mine anyway?

entries.jp: 何だと？
entries.en: What?

entries.jp: 今日の雷舞では\nオレ様が一番歌ったし\nオレ様が目立ってた
entries.en:
In today's live,
yours truly sang
the most, and
yours truly stood
out the most.

entries.jp: このオレ様　高杉晋作の\n一人雷舞だったと言って\n差支えないだろう
entries.en:
It's fair to say
it was the
great Shinsaku
Takasugi's solo
live.

entries.jp: つまり饅頭を食う権利は\nオレ様にある
entries.en:
So the right to
eat the manju
belongs to
yours truly.

entries.jp: 言いたいことは\nそれだけか？
entries.en: Is that all you\nhave to say?

entries.jp: ああ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 慶喜様は　饅頭を\n平等に分けろと仰った
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama\nsaid to share the\nmanju equally.

entries.jp: 高杉\nお前は将軍の命に\n背くつもりか？
entries.en:
Takasugi. You
mean to defy
the shogun's
command?

entries.jp: フン　オレ様は誰にも\n服従しねぇ　オレ様の\n心の赴くまま生きるッ
entries.en:
Hmph. Yours
truly bows to
no one! I live
however my
heart pleases!

entries.jp: なるほど\n欲をかいて命を落とすか\nそれもよかろう
entries.en: I see. You'd throw\nyour life away out\nof greed. So be it.

entries.jp: 欲なんかじゃねえ\n当然の権利を主張した\nまでだ
entries.en:
It ain't greed.
I'm just
claiming what's
rightfully mine.

entries.jp: ほう……
……やるか？
entries.en: ...Want to\nsettle this?

entries.jp:
高杉が懐の拳銃に
手を触れる
土方も素早く刀を構えて
鯉口を切った
entries.en:
Takasugi laid a
hand on the pistol
inside his coat.
Hijikata swiftly
readied his
sword, thumbing
it loose from the
scabbard.

entries.jp: ちょっ\n二人とも落ち着いて
entries.en: Wh-- Both of\nyou, calm down!

entries.jp:
高杉と土方の間に
桂が割って入る
しかし二人は警戒を解かず
火花を散らし合っている
entries.en:
Katsura stepped
in between
Takasugi and
Hijikata. But
neither let
down his guard,
and sparks flew
between them.

entries.jp: 来いよ！　今日こそ\nそのカタい頭に風穴を\n開けてやる！
entries.en:
Bring it! Today
I'm putting a
hole in that thick
skull of yours!

entries.jp: できるのか？\nお前が撃鉄を起こす間に\nなますに刻んでやろう
entries.en:
Can you? Before
you can cock
the hammer, I'll
have you sliced
to ribbons.

entries.jp: 言うじゃねェか\n試してみるか？
entries.en: Big talk.\nWanna test it?

entries.jp: 望むところだ
entries.en: Gladly.

entries.jp: ああもう……\n手が付けられない
entries.en: Oh, honestly...\nThey're out of\ncontrol.

entries.jp: 困ったなぁ\n私の名案で　話は丸く\n収まると思ったのに
entries.en:
Oh dear. I was
sure my brilliant
idea would settle
everything nicely.

entries.jp: ていうかさ\n名案ってほどでも\nないでしょ
entries.en: I mean, it\nwasn't really\nthat brilliant.

entries.jp: ……なんですって？
entries.en: ...I beg your\npardon?

entries.jp: 散々もったいぶるから\nどんな名案かと思いきや\n饅頭を四等分だなんて
entries.en:
You made such a
big production
of it, I wondered
what genius idea
was coming, and
it's cutting the
manju into
quarters?

entries.jp: そんなの\n虫でも思いつくよ
entries.en: Even a bug could\nthink of that.

entries.jp: む　虫……
entries.en: A b-bug...

entries.jp: そもそも発想が\n貧乏くさいんだよね\nはー　貧乏くさっ
entries.en:
The whole
idea's just so
cheapskate.
Ugh, so cheap.

entries.jp: ぐぐぐ……\nじゃあ　沖田君なら\nどうするんですか
entries.en: Grrr... Then\nwhat would you\ndo, Okita-kun?

entries.jp: 土方さんとスカシくんは\n喧嘩で忙しいみたいだし
entries.en: Hijikata-san and\nMr. Poser seem\nbusy fighting,

entries.jp: メガネくんは\n二人の仲裁で大変そうだし
entries.en:
and Glasses-kun
looks like he's got
his hands full
refereeing them...

entries.jp: 本当は皆で食べたいけど\nこの状況じゃ仕方ないよね\n饅頭は僕一人で処分しよ
entries.en:
I'd really rather
we all ate them
together, but in
this situation,
it can't be
helped. I'll just
take care of the
manju myself.

entries.jp: 満面の愛獲笑顔を浮かべ\n沖田が饅頭の箱に\n手を伸ばす
entries.en:
With a beaming
idol smile, Okita
reached for the
box of manju.

entries.jp: すると――
entries.en: Just then--

entries.jp: \fnt1待った\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Hold it!\fnt0

entries.jp: 沖田の動きを　\n土方　高杉　桂\nの三人が牽制した
entries.en:
Hijikata,
Takasugi and
Katsura moved
as one to check
Okita's hand.

entries.jp: 総司\nその手をどけろ
entries.en: Soji. Get your\nhand off that.

entries.jp: 黙って聞いてりゃ\n好き放題言いやがって
entries.en:
I've kept my
mouth shut
and listened,
and you've
been saying
whatever the
hell you please.

entries.jp: その饅頭はオレ様のだ
entries.en: That manju\nbelongs to\nyours truly.

entries.jp: 土方にも沖田にも\n絶対に譲らねぇ……\n桂さんにもだっ
entries.en:
I'm not giving
it up to Hijikata
or Okita... or to
you either,
Katsura-san!

entries.jp: ふふふ\n気が合いますね\n晋作
entries.en: Heh heh. We\nthink alike,\nShinsaku.

entries.jp: 私も　この饅頭を\n譲る気はありません
entries.en:
I have no
intention of
giving up this
manju either.

entries.jp: 何が何でも等分に\nしてみせます
entries.en: One way or\nanother, I will see\nit divided equally.

entries.jp: うわあ
entries.en: Wow.

entries.jp: 饅頭欲しさに\n喧嘩をするなんて\n大人げないなぁ
entries.en: Fighting over\na manju?\nHow childish.

entries.jp: 総司　ならば\nお前は饅頭から\n手を引くのか
entries.en: Soji. Then are\nyou backing away\nfrom the manju?

entries.jp: えー　\nそのつもりは無いですよ\nだって僕　子供だし？
entries.en:
Hmm, nope, I'm
not planning to.
I mean, I'm just
a kid, right?

entries.jp: フン\nどいつもこいつも\n譲る気はねぇってことか
entries.en:
Hmph. So every
last one of you
refuses to give
it up, huh.

entries.jp: そのようですね
entries.en: So it would seem.

entries.jp: じゃあ　さっさと\nカタをつけようよ\nどうせ僕が勝つけど
entries.en:
Then let's settle
this already. Not
that it matters--
I'm gonna win
anyway.

entries.jp: 勝負は\nやってみないと分からない\nいざ　尋常に勝負ッッ
entries.en:
You never know
who wins a fight
until you fight it.
Now--have at you,
fair and square!

entries.jp: 夕空に不吉な音が響き渡り\nカラスが一斉に飛び立つ
entries.en:
An ominous
sound echoed
across the
evening sky, and
the crows took
flight all at once.

entries.jp: 四人の誉れ高い侍による\n饅頭を賭けた熱い戦いが\n今　始まった――
entries.en:
A fiery battle
among four
honorable
samurai, with a
manju at stake,
had now begun--

entries.jp: その頃　坂本龍馬は一人　\n江戸の町を歩いていた
entries.en:
Meanwhile,
Ryoma Sakamoto
was walking
alone through the
streets of Edo.

entries.jp: は～っ\nヨッシーの誕生日\n盛り上がったなぁ
entries.en: Whew~ Yosshi's\nbirthday party\nsure was a blast!

entries.jp: 今日はヨッシーとも\nいっぱい歌えたし\n楽しかったぜよ！
entries.en:
I got to sing a
whole bunch with
Yosshi today too.
What a time!

entries.jp: 来年の誕生日のために\nもっともっと\n雷舞の練習をしないとな
entries.en:
Gotta practice
for our live even
harder before his
next birthday!

entries.jp: 大きく膨らんだ\n風呂敷を振り回し\n龍馬は高杉達のもとへ急ぐ
entries.en:
Swinging a big,
bulging cloth
bundle around,
Ryoma hurried
back to Takasugi
and the others.

entries.jp: その時――
entries.en: Just then--

entries.jp: きゃあーっ！
entries.en: Eeeek!

entries.jp: 町娘の甲高い叫び声が\n響いた
entries.en: A townswoman's\nshrill scream\nrang out.

entries.jp: どうした
entries.en: What's wrong?

entries.jp: 喧嘩よ\n男達が暴れてるの
entries.en: A fight! Some\nmen are\ngoing wild!

entries.jp: 銃を撃ったり\n真剣で斬り合ったり\nもう大変
entries.en:
Firing guns,
slashing at
each other with
real swords...
it's total chaos!

entries.jp: それに見たこともない\nカラクリを動かしている\n男もいたわ！
entries.en:
And one of them
was working
some contraption
I've never seen
before!

entries.jp: ほう\nそれは楽しそうぜよ
entries.en: Oho! Now that\nsounds like a\ngood time!

entries.jp: えっ？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: 火事と喧嘩は江戸の華\nなんて聞くが　本当の\nことだったんじゃな！
entries.en:
They say fires
and fights are
the flowers of
Edo, and I
reckon it's true!

entries.jp: ええ\nそ　そうね……
entries.en: Y-yes... I\nsuppose...

entries.jp: なあに\n喧嘩するほど仲がええ\nとも言うぜよ
entries.en:
Aw, y'know
what they say:
the more you
fight, the
closer you are.

entries.jp: きっと　その連中も\n仲が良すぎてじゃれ\n合うとるだけじゃ
entries.en:
I bet those fellas
are just such
good pals they're
roughhousin' a
little.

entries.jp: そういう風には\n見えなかったけど……
entries.en: It didn't look\nlike that to me...

entries.jp: 気が済むまで\nやらせておけばええ
entries.en: Let 'em go at\nit till they've\nhad their fill.

entries.jp: じゃ　わしは\n急ぎの用があるから\nまたな！
entries.en: Well, I got\nsomewhere to be\nin a hurry. See ya!

entries.jp: あっ\n止めなくて\nいいのかしら……
entries.en: Oh... Shouldn't\nsomebody\nstop them...?

entries.jp: 勝の屋敷
entries.en: Katsu's Residence

entries.jp:
紅白饅頭が入った箱を
睨みながら　四人の死闘は
いよいよ終わりに
近づいていた
entries.en:
The four glared
at the box of
red-and-white
manju as their
deadly struggle
at last drew
near its end.

entries.jp: いい加減に\nあきらめやがれ
entries.en: Give it up\nalready, dammit!

entries.jp: 士道に退却なし！\n饅頭のためなら\n命を賭ける覚悟よ！
entries.en:
The way of the
samurai knows no
retreat! For this
manju, I am ready
to stake my life!

entries.jp: ラッキー\n二人がやりあってる間に\n饅頭は僕のものだ
entries.en:
Lucky! While
those two go at
it, the manju's
all mine.

entries.jp: 抜け駆けは許しません\n饅頭に触れた途端\nドカンですからね
entries.en:
No sneaking
ahead, if you
please. The
moment you
touch that
manju--boom.

entries.jp: ぐぬぬ
entries.en: Grrr...

entries.jp: むう
entries.en: Mm...

entries.jp: ただいま\n帰ったぜよ
entries.en: I'm back,\neverybody!

entries.jp: おう　おかえり\n土方！\n動くんじゃねえ！
entries.en: Yeah, welcome\nback. Hijikata!\nDon't you move!

entries.jp: やー　毎度のことながら\n道に迷ってしまったぜよ
entries.en:
Haha, same
as always, I
went and got
myself lost!

entries.jp: それは大変だったな\n桂！\n妙な真似をするな！
entries.en:
Must have been
rough. Katsura!
Don't try
anything funny!

entries.jp: お？　饅頭じゃないか\n歩きすぎて腹が減って\nたんだ
entries.en:
Oh? Manju! I
walked so far
I worked up a
real appetite.

entries.jp: ちょうどよかった\nいただきまーす
entries.en: Perfect timing!\nDon't mind if I do!

entries.jp: \fnt1あっ\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Ah!\fnt0

entries.jp: ひどい！\nふたついっぺんに\n丸飲みした
entries.en:
That's awful! He
swallowed two
of them whole
in one gulp!

entries.jp: テメェ！\n今すぐ吐き出せ
entries.en: You bastard! Spit\nit out right now!

entries.jp: 腹をかっ捌いて\n饅頭を取り出す
entries.en: I'll slice open your\nbelly and take the\nmanju back.

entries.jp: ぶはっ\nなんじゃ\nなんじゃ
entries.en: Bwah! What?\nWhat's goin' on?

entries.jp: わしが何をしたって\nいうぜよ
entries.en: What in the\nworld did I do?

entries.jp: さすがにこれは\n弁解の余地はないよ\nトサカくん
entries.en: Sorry, but there's\nno excuse for this\none, Tosaka-kun.

entries.jp: さあ　苦しまずに\n死ねる毒ですよ！\n一気に飲んで
entries.en:
Here, a poison
that lets you die
without
suffering! Drink
it all in one go.

entries.jp: み　みんな目が\n怖いぜよ\n一体何があったんじゃ？
entries.en:
Y-you all got
real scary eyes...
What in the
world happened?

entries.jp: 高杉達は　龍馬に\n饅頭を巡る諍いについて\n説明した
entries.en:
Takasugi and the
others explained
the manju
dispute to Ryoma.

entries.jp: というわけです
entries.en: And that is\nthe situation.

entries.jp: なるほどなあ\nそんなことで\nケンカしとったんか
entries.en:
I see. So y'all
were fightin'
over somethin'
like that?

entries.jp: そんなことだと？
entries.en: Something\nlike that?

entries.jp: 貴様　俺達の命を\n賭した戦いを侮辱する\nつもりか？
entries.en:
You mean to
insult a battle
we staked
our lives on?

entries.jp: そうじゃなくて\nほれ
entries.en: That ain't what I\nmeant. Here, look.

entries.jp: そう言うと　龍馬は\n背負っていた大きな\n風呂敷包みを開けて見せる
entries.en:
With that, Ryoma
opened up the big
cloth bundle he'd
been carrying on
his back.

entries.jp: 包みの中から\n山のような紅白饅頭が\nゴロゴロと現れた
entries.en:
Out of the
bundle tumbled
a mountain of
red-and-white
manju.

entries.jp: うおっ！\nなんだこりゃ
entries.en: Whoa! What\nthe hell is this?

entries.jp: 龍馬くん　これは？
entries.en: Ryoma-kun,\nwhat is this?

entries.jp: 見ての通り\n紅白饅頭ぜよ
entries.en: Red-and-white\nmanju, plain\nas day!

entries.jp: おい　どういう事だ？\nこの饅頭は品切れだったろ\n何でこんなに持ってる
entries.en:
Hey, what's the
deal? This
manju was sold
out. Why've you
got so many?

entries.jp: ふっふっふ\nそれはな……
entries.en: Heh heh heh.\nWell, y'see...

entries.jp: あんまりうまそう\nだったから　ヨッシーに\n頼んでもらったんじゃ
entries.en:
They looked so
tasty, I asked
Yosshi to get
me some.

entries.jp: 一度　饅頭を山のように\n食べてみたいって言ったら\nこんなにくれたぜよ
entries.en:
I told him I
wanted to eat a
whole mountain
of manju just
once, and he
gave me all these!

entries.jp: へーえ……
entries.en: Is that so...

entries.jp: 慶喜様に頼んで\nこの饅頭を確保して\nもらったと……
entries.en:
You asked
Yoshinobu-sama,
and had him
secure these
manju for you...

entries.jp: その通りぜよ
entries.en: That's right!

entries.jp: そういうことか……
entries.en: So that's\nhow it is...

entries.jp: つまり坂本のせいで\n饅頭の絶対数が最初から\n少なかったというわけか
entries.en:
In other words,
thanks to
Sakamoto, there
were too few
manju from the
very start.

entries.jp: 俺達のところに饅頭が\n回ってこなかったのは\n坂本のせいだったんだな
entries.en:
The reason no
manju made it
around to us
was Sakamoto.

entries.jp: へっ？\nヒジゾーさん？
entries.en: Huh? Hijizo-san?

entries.jp: ははは\nそういうことか
entries.en: Hahaha. So\nthat's how it is.

entries.jp: オレ様たちが\nさっきまで下らない\n争いをしてたのは
entries.en:
The reason yours
truly and the
rest were having
that stupid fight
just now...

entries.jp: 全部　このバカの\nせいだったってワケだ
entries.en: ...was all because\nof this idiot.

entries.jp: えっ\nシンディ？
entries.en: Huh? Shindy?

entries.jp: 四人の背後から立ち上る\n怒りのオーラに　さすがの\n龍馬も気付いたようだ
entries.en:
Even Ryoma
seemed to notice
the aura of rage
rising up behind
the four of them.

entries.jp: 四人は龍馬を\n素早く囲い込むと\nにっこりと笑顔を浮かべた
entries.en:
The four swiftly
surrounded
Ryoma and
broke into big,
beaming smiles.

entries.jp: 報酬を独り占めする\n龍馬くんには
entries.en:
For Ryoma-kun,
who kept the
reward all to
himself...

entries.jp: きつーいお仕置きが\n必要なようですね
entries.en: ...it seems a very\nharsh punishment\nis in order.

entries.jp: 手加減ナシで\nぶっ放してやる\n覚悟しろ
entries.en:
I'm letting
loose with no
holding back.
Brace yourself.

entries.jp: 成敗してあげるよ\nトサカくん？
entries.en:
Time for your
punishment,
okay,
Tosaka-kun?

entries.jp: 骨は拾ってやる\n安心して逝け
entries.en: I'll gather\nyour bones.\nDie in peace.

entries.jp: な　なあ　みんな\n喧嘩はやめるぜよ……\nわあああああああー！
entries.en:
N-now, now,
everybody, let's
quit fightin'...
Waaaaaaaah!

entries.jp: 龍馬の叫び声が　\n江戸の空に響く
entries.en: Ryoma's scream\nechoed across\nthe sky of Edo.

entries.jp:
彼等の一日は
今日もこうして
賑やかに
過ぎてゆくのだった
entries.en:
And so, once
again, their
day went by in
lively fashion.
